objective: Determine whether Sentaurus DirectCurrent closes the remaining distinction among the M50 default substrate eCurrent, the M51 CurrentWeighting observable, and the M50 native substrate electron contact-face flux while preserving the solved six-state fields.

manual_basis.default_contact_current: doping-well surface current-density integral plus doping-well volume charge-generation integral
manual_basis.DirectCurrent: surface integral of current density over the contact area
manual_basis.mutual_exclusion: CurrentWeighting and DirectCurrent are alternative mutually exclusive approaches

scope.baseline_default: frozen M50 CurrentWeighting-off and DirectCurrent-off replay
scope.intervention: add only the DirectCurrent flag to the otherwise byte-equivalent M50 global Math section

diagnostic_replay.input_tdrs: exact M50 input_fps.tdr copies inherited from frozen M8 process outputs
diagnostic_replay.deck_rule: M50 deck with diagnostic output names changed from M50 to M52 and the single DirectCurrent flag added to Math; no other semantic change
diagnostic_replay.native_face_observable: CurrentPlot Tcl Integrate Contact=substrate IntegrationUnit=cm of eCurrentDensity dot ContactSurfaceNormal

state_invariance.baseline_snapshots: six frozen M50 m50_state TDR files
state_invariance.direct_snapshots: six new M52 m52_state TDR files
state_invariance.rule: each compared value passes when either its absolute or symmetric relative difference is within threshold

analysis.terminal_comparison: compare DirectCurrent source, drain, gate, and substrate electron, hole, and total currents with frozen M50 default and M51 CurrentWeighting values
analysis.native_flux_comparison: compare DirectCurrent-run substrate electron contact-domain flux in both normal orientations with frozen M50 native flux

classifications.direct_matches_native_face: state invariant and DirectCurrent substrate eCurrent closes to either fixed native-face orientation at all six states
classifications.direct_matches_weighted: state invariant and DirectCurrent substrate eCurrent closes to M51 CurrentWeighting at all six states but not native face
classifications.direct_matches_default: state invariant and DirectCurrent substrate eCurrent closes to M50 default at all six states but not native face or weighted
classifications.direct_third_observable: state invariant but DirectCurrent substrate eCurrent closes to none of the three frozen observables
classifications.state_perturbed: any required solved field exceeds the frozen state-invariance threshold
classifications.replay_incomplete: required states or observables are missing

analysis.target_localization: report DirectCurrent-minus-default, DirectCurrent-minus-weighted, and DirectCurrent-minus-nearest-native residuals at the target, adjacent n23 gates, and matched n19 gate
analysis.claim_guard: M52 attributes a Sentaurus observation algorithm only; it does not authorize changing Vela or Sentaurus production defaults

forbidden_work: BGN, SRH, mobility, contact model, mesh, or production-default changes
adding HeteroInterface, Thermionic, or Discontinuity physics
rewriting M8 or M45 through M51 artifacts
deliverables: regression test for contract and evidence invariants
